lines.t: [Intro - low organ, rising sub]
Not just the mouth.
Not just the moment.
Not just the feeling when the bass comes in.
Hands.
Mind.
Heart.
Strength.
Whole life.
[Beat drops]
Feet hit the floor, give thanks for the breath.
Life isn't mine just to spend on myself.
Strength in my frame, put it under Your will.
Big talk's cheap if my hands stay still.
Use these arms when a burden needs lifting.
Use this mind when a neighbor needs listening.
Read with attention, examine my ways.
Don't bend the truth just to win my case.
Heart full of feeling? Let feeling bear fruit.
Joy in the doing, not only the tune.
I can lift up my hands with a room full of sound—
Will I reach for the one everybody walks round?
No crown for the ego, no stage for my name.
I don't serve mercy to purchase acclaim.
You gave the gift; I don't earn that love.
Let the faith in my chest get its work boots on.
Whose breath?
NOT MINE TO BOAST!
Whose strength?
GIVEN, NOT OWNED!
What now?
PUT LOVE TO WORK!
Whole life—
LET THE LORD BE FIRST!
Whole body! Whole yes!
Heart and mind and all my strength!
YahuShua-YAHUWAH,
Let my living speak Your praise!
Not just louder—
Let it go deeper!
Truth in the choices
When nobody sees us!
Whole body! Whole yes!
Joy in walking in Your ways!
Let the beat move these feet—
Let obedience shape my days!
Beloved ones, serve Me as I have loved you...
Says The LORD.
Somebody hungry? Make room at the table.
Somebody tired? Do what I am able.
Not just a prayer while I guard my excess—
Let the answer involve what I haven't spent yet.
Someone needs credit? I don't need the spotlight.
Somebody wronged me? Don't sharpen the spite.
Speak what is true, keep the vengeance away.
Love doesn't mean I call evil okay.
Care for this body; it isn't a trophy.
Train for the service, not so they adore me.
Feed it and rest it, don't worship the mirror.
The temple is His—let the purpose get clearer.
Strong doesn't mean that I never need aid.
Faith isn't proved by the pain I create.
Rest when it's needful; get help when I need it.
Steward what's given, don't punish or bleed it.
And remember, whatsoever you do
For another, you have done it for Me;
Says The LORD.
FOR THE LEAST!
NOT THE LIKES!
FOR HIS NAME!
NOT MY HEIGHT!
Hands open!
Head bowed!
Stand faithful!
Live it out!
FOR THE LEAST!
NOT THE LIKES!
FOR HIS NAME!
NOT MY HEIGHT!
Hands open!
Head bowed!
Stand faithful!
Live it out!
Without faith, it's impossible to please Him.
So I won't call distrust a deeper kind of reason.
Believing isn't swagger, isn't naming my demand.
It's trusting what He said enough to do what I can.
Prove it to myself when the easy way is lying.
Prove it in the checkout when the temper starts rising.
Not to earn salvation, not to purchase His embrace—
Let the works bear witness to the gift of grace.
And yes, I've fallen.
Yes, I've stalled.
Sang about surrender
While protecting little walls.
But I won't make shame a second throne.
Won't call the old chains coming home.
Confess it, turn, accept correction.
Mercy's not a pass to keep the same direction.
Begin again in Me,
says The Lord,
for I have not left you.
Then here I am with empty hands,
Not bringing You a finished man.
But willing to be taught again,
And willing to make right what I can.
Let my sorrow turn me toward You.
Let my gladness make me give.
Let the hunger for Your presence
Reach the ordinary way I live.
I want more than holy language.
More than tears that never move.
Let the child who calls You Father
Find delight in pleasing You.
If I love You, let me listen.
If I trust You, let me act.
If I fail, let me return—
Not hide behind the fact.
With my mind, let me attend.
With my strength, let me assist.
With my heart, let me forgive.
With my life, let me say yes!
Beloved, serve Me as I have loved you,
And do so rejoicing as you go,
For I am with you...
Says The LORD.
Whole body! Whole yes!
Heart and mind and all my strength!
YahuShua-YAHUWAH,
Let my living speak Your praise!
Not just louder—
Let it go deeper!
Truth in the choices
When nobody sees us!
Whole body! Whole yes!
Joy in walking in Your ways!
Let the beat move these feet—
Let obedience shape my days!
When the music stops...
The offering doesn't.
There's a life to live.
Lord—
Receive it.
